non_blocking.suggestion: The Summary says retirement ends an in-flight request 'only if it outlives K + 1 further activations and then a 30 s grace period (target)'. Streams on a closing snapshot end at once, with no grace period (Configuration snapshots and hot reload, reason 4). Add 'streams at once' so the contract line matches the body.

The H3 'Why no in-flight request is dropped' still overclaims, and its lead sentence uses 'request' before the next sentence defines it. Rename the H3 to 'Why the swap drops no in-flight request', or put the stream and request definitions before the retirement bound.

Reason 5 delays activation by up to the 30 s grace period plus compile time (target). That fits under the 60 s Control Stream ACK timeout in Control plane and GitOps (target), but the document does not say so. Add a half sentence noting that the delay stays under the ACK timeout, so the Node does not look like a Rollout laggard, and link OQ-data-plane-13.

The SNI paragraph ('Each `https` listener picks a certificate...') and the Route timeout paragraph ('The Route `timeout` bounds a whole SSE stream...') sit on adjacent lines with no blank line between them, so they render as one paragraph about two unrelated topics. Insert a blank line.

Worked example row `GET api.shop.example/v1/orders/42/summary`: 'Only the four-segment template matches' is imprecise, because `orders-any` (prefix `/v1/orders`) also matches. Write 'Template beats prefix; `orders-get` has too few segments'.

Drain still says in-flight requests finish 'within a bounded time' but gives no value and no owner. Name a (target) value, or point at Zero-downtime upgrades and hot reload as the owner, and say what a Drain does to streams, which GOAWAY lets run until their Route timeout.

Bounded resources still covers only client listeners. Give the 9901 admin server's own connection ceiling and timeouts, so that `/tap` subscribers and `/debug/pprof/` holders cannot hold unbounded connections.
'(proposed default 16, target)' is still not the standard tag form. Write 'proposed default 16 (target)'.

The `ruralz-partial: true` response header appears in neither the Configuration model nor the System overview. State that this document owns Ruralz-generated response header names, or propose the name to CLI and API surface.
